_comment: Shared OCR text-filter cases, read by internal/ocr (isTranslatable) and extension/src/ocr-text.js (isTranslatable). The CJK class is by Unicode script - Han, Hiragana, Katakana, Hangul - on both sides, astral planes included (audit finding B38). See docs/PARITY.md, OCR noise filter.

cases.text: Get your food, drink & duty free delivered before the trolley.

cases.about: halfwidth Katakana (U+FF71..): Katakana by script, outside the old BMP ranges
Hangul compatibility jamo (U+3131..): Hangul by script
astral Han (CJK Extension B): one character is two UTF-16 units
prolonged sound mark: Common script, a letter but not a CJK one - too few letters
Katakana middle dot: Common script punctuation, no letters
